applies_why: The judge text resolves the Isaiah 7:14 dispute by the sign verse's own silence on mechanism, a verse-level move that K-C governs.
quote: the sign itself does not state the mechanism.
rule_words: When the witnesses pressed against a link are the pressing side's own chain read together, the collision weighs chain against chain by footing, never verse by verse; that no one of them states the contrary in its own words is the stating-verse test DG-61 retires, at a judge's seat as at a debater's, for either side.
room: never verse by verse — one reading requires chain-by-footing before any verdict; the other allows a single verse's silence on mechanism to decide the collision.
why: By making the sign's own failure to state the mechanism the deciding point, the judge uses a verse-level stating test instead of weighing CR2's and DR3's chains by footing, so it breaches K-C.
